_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Live delivery remains visible and replyable in brief view: the conversation lets the agent message the user (message_user on). The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. Call "snapshot turns" counts the conversation's messages that end a turn, as the server has them; call "more turns" says whether there are more now; call "reply" has the agent reply to the spoken request through the API, with message_user {"text": "On it.", "reply_to": <the spoken request's sequence_id>, "reaction": "👍", "end_turn": true}, and returns "sent" once done. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/brief and start the call. Call "snapshot turns".
2. Emit {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Review the build", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000}, then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 1000, delegation: {id: "brief", target: "client"}}.
3. The message "Spoken request: Review the build" (the request) should be visible. Call "more turns" should come to return exactly "true".
4. Call "reply" should return exactly "sent".
5. The data-testid "message-user-bubble" containing "On it." should have a data-testid "message-user-quote" containing "Review the build", and the request's data-testid "message-reactions" should have text exactly "👍".
6. Click data-testid "live-stop".

steps.expression: window.liveEmit({type: 'session.input_transcript.delta', delta: 'Review the build', start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000})
